tagline: Right now you're the best-kept secret in your own industry.

problem.heading: Nobody Googles a person they've never heard say anything.
problem.body: You're doing the work — the results are real. But there's no trail leading back to you. No POV out in the world, no reason for a stranger to trust you before they've met you. Every referral is starting from zero, every time.

pillars.title: Position
pillars.body: One sentence that tells people exactly what you're the person to call for — and what you're not.

pillars.title: Publish
pillars.body: A steady drumbeat of writing that sounds like you thinking out loud, not a brand account.

pillars.title: Prove
pillars.body: Case studies and receipts that turn 'I think they're good' into 'I've seen the numbers.'

deliverables: Positioning statement + one-line bio for every platform
LinkedIn profile rebuild (headline, banner, about, featured)
12 posts/month written in your voice, not a template
1 case study or proof-point post every 2 weeks
Monthly content calendar, sent 1 week ahead for your review
Quarterly review: what worked, what didn't, what's next

pricingTiers.name: Momentum
pricingTiers.blurb: Everything in Foundation, plus proof and consistency.

pricingTiers.name: Authority
pricingTiers.blurb: For when the brand is the business.

timeline.what: Positioning workshop + audit of what exists today
Profile rebuild + first month's calendar drafted
First posts go live, review rhythm begins
